description: This file implements client and server components for managing execution approvals via socket communication, handling command prompts, decision responses, socket connection management, and request evaluation within a macOS application context.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton managing the lifecycle of the socket server that handles execution approval requests and responses.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: Handles socket creation, listening, accepting client connections, and processing approval and execution requests asynchronously.

classes.name: ExecHostExecutor
classes.description: Contains logic for handling execution requests, including validation, prompting for approval, and running commands.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a decision from external socket service with timeout support.

methods.name: requestDecisionSync
methods.description: Synchronously communicates via UNIX socket to request an approval decision.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server to listen for incoming approval and execution requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and cleans up socket files.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles individual client connections, dispatching approval prompts or execution commands.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Builds an execution context for the given request, including validation and evaluation.

methods.name: persistAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Stores an always-allow list entry if the decision is allowAlways and security policy permits.

methods.name: ensureScreenRecordingAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests permission for screen recording if needed for command execution.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command with environment, working directory, and timeout settings, returning structured result.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Constructs an error response with specific code and message.

methods.name: successResponse
methods.description: Creates a success response with execution payload.
